name: cmake
description: Command-line interface of the cross-platform buildsystem generator CMake

options.name: -S
options.description: Path to root directory of the CMake project to build

options.name: -B
options.description: Path to directory which CMake will use as the root of build directory. If the directory doesn't already exist CMake will make it

options.name: -C
options.description: Pre-load a script to populate the cache

options.name: -D
options.description: Create or update a CMake CACHE entry

options.name: -U
options.description: Remove matching entries from CMake CACHE

options.name: -G
options.description: Specify a build system generator

options.name: -T
options.description: Toolset specification for the generator, if supported

options.name: -A
options.description: Specify platform name if supported by generator

options.name: --install-prefix
options.description: Specify the installation directory, used by the CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX variable. Must be an absolute path

options.name: -Wno-dev
options.description: Suppress developer warnings

options.name: -Wdev
options.description: Enable developer warnings

options.name: -Werror
options.description: Enable the type of warnings

suggestions.name: deprecated
suggestions.description: Make deprecated macro and function warnings errors

options.name: -Wno-error
options.description: Disable the type of warnings

suggestions.name: deprecated
suggestions.description: Make deprecated macro and function warnings not errors

options.name: -Wdeprecated
options.description: Enable deprecated functionality warnings

options.name: -Wno-deprecated
options.description: Suppress deprecated functionality warnings

options.name: -L
options.description: List non-advanced cached-variables

options.name: -N
options.description: View mode only

options.name: --graphviz
options.description: Generate graphviz of dependencies

options.name: --system-information
options.description: Dump information about this system

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Set log-level

options.name: --log-context
options.description: Enable the message() command outputting context attached to each message

options.name: --debug-trycompile
options.description: Do not delete the try_compile() build tree

options.name: --debug-output
options.description: Put cmake in a debug mode

options.name: --debug-find
options.description: Put cmake find commands in a debug mode

options.name: --trace
options.description: Put cmake in trace mode

options.name: --trace-expand
options.description: Put cmake in trace mode with variables expanded

options.name: --trace-format
options.description: Put cmake in trace mode and sets the trace output format

options.name: --trace-source
options.description: Put cmake in trace mode, but output only lines of a specified file

options.name: --trace-redirect
options.description: Put cmake in trace mode and redirect trace output to a file instead of stderr

options.name: --warn-uninitialized
options.description: Warn about uninitialized values

options.name: --warn-unused-vars
options.description: Does nothing. In CMake versions 3.2 and below this enabled warnings about unused variables. In CMake versions 3.3 through 3.18 the option was broken. In CMake 3.19 and above the option has been removed

options.name: --no-warn-unused-cli
options.description: Don't warn about command line options. Don't find variables that are declared on the command line, but not used

options.name: --check-system-vars
options.description: Find problems with variable usage in system files

options.name: --preset
options.description: Reads a preset from <path-to-source>/CMakePresets.json and <path-to-source>/CMakeUserPresets.json. The preset may specify the generator and the build directory, and a list of variables and other arguments to pass to CMake. The current working directory must contain CMake preset files. The CMake GUI can also recognize CMakePresets.json and CMakeUserPresets.json files

options.name: --list-presets
options.description: Lists the available presets
